content: In SQA, each sample is a triple, INLINEFORM0 , where INLINEFORM1 is a question in either spoken or text form, INLINEFORM2 is a multi-sentence spoken-form document, and INLINEFORM3 is the answer in text from. The task of this work is extractive SQA; that means INLINEFORM4 is a word span from the reference transcription of INLINEFORM5 . An overview framework of SQA is shown in Figure FIGREF1 . In this paper, we frame the source domain as reference transcriptions and the target domain as ASR hypotheses. Hence, we can collect source domain data more easily, and adapt the model to the target domain.
